# ERP Boilerplate

ERP Boilerplate is an open-source, production-minded foundation for internal operations software.
It uses Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, cookie sessions, server-side RBAC, reusable CRUD systems, and operational demos.

- Website: https://erp-boilerplate.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/TheMisterPin/erp-boilerplate
- Licence: MIT
- Intended use: start domain-specific ERP, WMS, operations, scheduling, or internal-tool work without rebuilding authentication, role-based authorization, table CRUD, forms, and layout foundations.

It is a foundation, not a finished ERP. Inventory, purchasing, accounting, CRM, production tenancy, backups, email delivery, MFA, and durable session revocation are not included.
